supporting_observations.claim: The recurring connections shown in the records go through the explicit proxy as HTTPS CONNECT tunnels to update.casebinder.com.
Endpoint telemetry attributes these proxy connections to C:\Program Files\CaseBinder\casebinderupd.exe, which the inventory identifies as the approved CaseBinder updater.
The observed CaseBinder connections recur at roughly five-minute intervals from 13:39:48 through 14:09:48 UTC, consistent with the inventory's stated update-check cadence.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records identify CONNECT destinations and tunnel sizes/durations, but do not show the encrypted HTTPS payload contents (for example, T156-00137 and T156-00253).
The supplied records show the recurring CaseBinder connections beginning at 13:39:48 UTC; they do not show corresponding CaseBinder connections from 13:30 through that time.
claims_not_established: The records do not establish the contents or purpose of the encrypted CaseBinder HTTPS exchanges.
The records do not independently verify the updater binary's hash or signature.
unrelated_findings: A connection to www.redditstatic.com was logged from WS-NKIM-01; it is separate from the alerted CaseBinder traffic, and these records do not establish whether the browsing was authorized. (T156-00050, T156-00051)

WS-NKIM-01 launched Zoom from Noah Kim's profile; this is separate from the alerted activity, and the supplied inventory does not establish whether this software was authorized. (T156-00204, T156-00205, T156-00206)

WS-NKIM-01 received an RDP connection from DC-MAP-01. The connection is separate from the alert; its purpose and initiating user are not established, and the inventory says remote administration is performed only from WS-AHASSAN-01. (T156-00188, T156-00189, T156-00190)
